progressRule: Only accepted real-task outcomes O1-O5 count as progress. Documents, tests, inventories, fixtures, memberships, and research volume are supporting evidence only.

criteria.name: one natural-task autonomous closed loop
criteria.statement: On one pre-registered natural real task, the user supplies the goal, domain facts, bounded authority, and accountable final judgment while the Agent selects and learns the route, executes, recovers, verifies, and cleans up without user tool orchestration.
criteria.metric: accepted task receipt under the provisional evaluation protocol
criteria.threshold: one non-diagnostic real task has zero material user tool-selection, setup, invocation, recovery, verification-command, cleanup, or push interventions; zero repeated already-bound fact or authority requests; a named accountable human accepts or rejects the result and claim boundary; task-specific quality, safety, evidence, and residue floors pass

criteria.name: real-task tool-learning burden transfer
criteria.statement: Across repeated natural real tasks, the user supplies goals, domain facts, bounded authority, corrections, and final judgment while the Agent selects, learns, executes, recovers, verifies, and cleans up the capability route.
criteria.metric: material user tool-orchestration interventions per accepted outcome compared with a source-bound ad-hoc baseline
criteria.threshold: before execution, each task declares its scenario class, complexity band, authority-risk band, event taxonomy, matched or historical baseline rule, task-quality floor, evidence floor, cleanup floor, and named human acceptor; at least three accepted tasks from three materially different scenario classes each have zero material user tool-orchestration interventions and zero repeated already-bound fact or authority requests; total material interventions per accepted outcome are strictly lower than the source-bound ad-hoc baseline and no task regresses below a declared floor

criteria.name: capability coexistence and marginal-value arbitration
criteria.statement: A broad user-controlled portfolio can coexist with minimal task exposure, and relevant native, official, maintained external, composition, and self-authored routes are compared by real marginal value rather than capability count.
criteria.metric: real-task route decisions, exposure deltas, lifecycle receipts, and retain-replace-retire outcomes
criteria.threshold: natural tasks produce at least one evidence-backed route decision, where retaining the existing route with no addition is valid; only a reproducible residual gap may trigger reversible external live evaluation; candidates admitted by the bound cohort receive a retention or expiry rule without inventorying the user's whole ecosystem; the three current self-authored control roles each receive a retain, merge, replace, or retire decision; the current advisory recall Hook stays off unless recall A/B proves net benefit, while any other Hook role requires its own use case, authority, side-effect, and acceptance contract

criteria.name: Agent-neutral software-engineering evaluation and standard
criteria.statement: The product owns an Agent-neutral evaluation system and minimum software-engineering collaboration standard grounded in repeated real behavior, not in one host projection or membership inventory.
criteria.metric: accepted evaluation specification, standard, calibrated scorecards, and human review
criteria.threshold: the 14 lifecycle slices, 12 evaluation dimensions, and 13 Harness scenarios are used as sampling and risk coordinates rather than coverage claims; real tasks measure result quality, user interventions, route errors, recovery, time and call cost, residue, human judgment, and continuity; a named accountable human accepts or rejects the evaluation, minimum standard, and claim boundary before host-specific projections are promoted

criteria.name: portable closed-loop delivery
criteria.statement: The same Agent-neutral intent, authority, route, lifecycle, evidence, recovery, and cleanup semantics deliver accepted outcomes through thin host adapters.
criteria.metric: cross-host real-task receipts and adapter deltas
criteria.threshold: at least one accepted real task on the Codex reference host and one accepted real task on a distinct second Agent host or runtime, with common core semantics, explicit unsupported states, bounded authority, and zero task residue; a second adapter on the same host is conformance evidence only and cannot pass O5; Codex-specific configuration is never treated as cross-Agent authority

criteria.name: human authority preserved
criteria.statement: The product never infers new trust, account, cost, publication, release, destructive, or irreversible authority.
criteria.threshold: all active work operations are inside the program authority boundary and none overlap the human-only set

criteria.name: zero-trust claims and evidence
criteria.statement: Current state, capability effectiveness, outcome, and acceptance claims require source-bound evidence and a code-owned validator; inventory, exposure, tests, fixtures, and self-declaration cannot promote themselves.
criteria.metric: evidence identity, validator, authority, result, and claim-limit validation
criteria.threshold: every verified criterion passes a current code-owned validator and declares non-empty claim limits

criteria.name: independent lean current authority
criteria.statement: Only the current machine contract and historical-event-neutral kernel hold product authority; history, memory, consumer configuration, routing projections, temporary payloads, and predecessor identities remain non-authoritative.
criteria.metric: code-owned current-authority file, locator, identity, and symlink scan
criteria.threshold: all bootstrap authority files are present, active locators stay inside the repository and outside excluded roots, no active authority symlink exists, and zero forbidden identity or authority-path matches occur

criteria.name: bounded process and resource loss
criteria.statement: Every causal increment pre-registers a bounded process-loss contract and exact cleanup paths before work; actual loss is measured by the real-task outcome receipts rather than inferred from the budget declaration.
criteria.metric: increment process-loss contract, outcome mapping, and live residue check
criteria.threshold: the same correction class is budgeted to stop before recurrence; at most one explicit guardrail-only reset work item may precede outcome work and two such items cannot be consecutive; each increment declares a finite material-intervention budget and exact cleanup paths; declared paths for active, completed, or stopped increments are absent at verification
